caption: A woman plucks the string of a harp, and the string vibrates in a blur that narrows as the note fades.
expectation: The blur appears at the pluck and shrinks steadily to a sharp line; the other strings remain still.
removed_reason: harp string blur: invisible at video resolution; the plucked-string idea is covered by ACOU-0002/0008/0011

caption: A cook strikes a hanging metal triangle with a rod, and the triangle swings on its loop and its sides shimmer.
expectation: The shimmer begins at the strike and fades; the swinging is small and dies down; nothing moves before the rod touches it.
removed_reason: triangle sides shimmer: invisible; the hanging-ball demo now lives on the gong (ACOU-0003)

caption: A child flicks the tines of a fork held by its handle, and the tines blur briefly and then are still.
expectation: The blur starts at the flick and is gone within a second; the handle in the hand stays sharp.
removed_reason: fork tines blur: invisible; the tuning fork in water (ACOU-0007) covers it

caption: A child hits a suspended metal wind-chime tube with a stick, and the tube swings and its outline shimmers.
expectation: The struck tube swings and shimmers; neighbouring tubes move only if it bumps them; the motion dies down over a few seconds.
removed_reason: wind-chime tube outline shimmer: invisible; same class as the triangle/handbell

caption: A child strikes a hanging saucepan with a spoon, and the pan swings and its bottom shimmers.
expectation: The shimmer and swing begin at the strike and decay over a few seconds; the pan is still before.
removed_reason: hanging saucepan bottom shimmer: invisible; rice-on-lid demo (ACOU-0010) covers struck metal

caption: A boy bangs a metal garbage-can lid against the can, and the lid rings and quivers in his hand.
expectation: The quiver starts at the bang and dies within a second or two; the lid is still before and after.
removed_reason: garbage-can lid quivering in a hand: invisible and duplicates ACOU-0010

caption: A man strikes a hanging church-style handbell with its clapper, and the bell swings and its rim shimmers.
expectation: The shimmer begins as the clapper hits and fades; the swing settles; nothing moves before the clapper strikes.
removed_reason: handbell rim shimmer: invisible; ball demo kept on the gong, water demo on the fork

caption: A man taps a thin metal lampshade with a pen, and the shade rings and its edge blurs faintly before settling.
expectation: The blur appears at the tap and fades within seconds; the lamp itself does not sway unless bumped.
removed_reason: lampshade edge blur: invisible

caption: Fireworks explode overhead during a display, and the loose glass in a greenhouse below rattles with each bang.
expectation: Each rattle follows a burst and dies away before the next; the glass is still between bursts.
removed_reason: greenhouse glass rattling with fireworks: invisible on video; window-buzz idea kept in ACOU-0038/0040 with paper indicators

caption: A church bell rings in a tower, and the small loose panes of the belfry window quiver with each stroke.
expectation: Each quiver comes with a stroke of the bell and settles between strokes.
removed_reason: belfry panes quivering with bell strokes: invisible; same as above

caption: A giant firework shell bursts over a lake, and the reflection on the water shivers into fragments a moment after the bang.
expectation: The reflection breaks up briefly after each burst and reforms as the surface settles.
removed_reason: a firework bang does not visibly shiver a lake's reflection: physics not sound

caption: A woman blows into a harmonica, and the reeds inside can be seen quivering through the openings while she plays.
expectation: The reeds move only while air is blown and are still between breaths.
removed_reason: harmonica reeds seen through the openings: not visible

caption: A violinist plays a long note, and the string under the bow is a blur that clears the instant the bow stops.
expectation: Only the bowed string blurs; the blur is present exactly while the bow moves.
removed_reason: violin string blur under the bow: invisible; the cello (ACOU-0073) keeps the bowed-string case

caption: A trumpet player blows a note, and the bell of the trumpet trembles faintly while the note sounds.
expectation: The tremble appears while he blows and is gone when he stops.
removed_reason: trumpet bell trembling: not visible

caption: A bagpiper plays, and the drones resting on his shoulder tremble faintly while the note holds.
expectation: The drones tremble only while air flows through them and are still when he stops.
removed_reason: bagpipe drones trembling: not visible

caption: A stack of dry pasta sheets stands on a shelf above a running dishwasher, and the sheets buzz against each other while the machine runs.
expectation: The buzzing lasts as long as the machine runs and stops at the end of the cycle.
removed_reason: pasta sheets buzzing above a dishwasher: not visible

caption: A man drops a heavy weight onto a gym floor, and the metal plates on a nearby rack ring and shiver.
expectation: The shiver starts at the impact and fades within a second or two; the plates are still before.
removed_reason: weight plates shivering after a dropped weight: not visible

caption: Someone bangs a bass drum in a school gym, and a row of basketballs on a rack gently rock in their cradles.
expectation: The rocking begins with the drum hits and dies down after they stop.
removed_reason: a bass drum does not visibly rock basketballs on a rack: physics doubtful

caption: A large clock strikes the hour in a hallway, and a nearby vase of flowers trembles faintly with each chime.
expectation: The tremble comes with each chime and dies between chimes; the flowers are still when the clock is silent.
removed_reason: a clock chime does not visibly shake a vase: not visible / doubtful

caption: A guitarist strums a chord, and all the strings blur together and then sharpen one by one as she damps them with her palm.
expectation: The blur begins at the strum and each string stops the instant the palm touches it.
removed_reason: strummed strings blurring then damped: high strings invisible; plucked-string idea covered by 2/8/20

caption: A ringing old-fashioned telephone shakes slightly on its table, and the shaking stops when the handset is lifted.
expectation: The shaking coincides with the ringing bursts and ends the moment the handset is picked up.
removed_reason: old telephone shaking while ringing: too small; the vibrating pager covers it

caption: A boy holds a running electric razor against his palm, and the razor's head buzzes and blurs until he switches it off.
expectation: The head blurs only while the razor runs and is sharp when it is off.
removed_reason: razor head blur: duplicates the buzzing-device cases (phone, toothbrush, massager)

caption: A hand-cranked siren is wound faster and faster, and its casing vibrates more as the pitch climbs, then settles as the crank slows.
expectation: The vibration rises and falls with the cranking speed and stops when the crank stops.
removed_reason: hand-cranked siren casing vibration: not visible; only the crank is

caption: An old refrigerator compressor kicks on, and the fridge shudders briefly and a magnet on its door quivers.
expectation: The shudder happens as the compressor starts and settles into a faint hum; it stops when the compressor cuts out.
removed_reason: fridge compressor shudder and magnet quiver: too small
